copy.curiosityHook: With the Red Ribbon Army actively hunting Goku from the start, how will these newly formed alliances withstand being tracked down so early?
copy.description: In this retold origin, Goku crosses paths with Bulma and Kame-Sen'nin under new circumstances, quickly drawing the attention of the Red Ribbon Army, who actively hunt him down instead of waiting to be found.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-moving fantasy adventure, moderate stakes, and vibrant animated excitement built for engaged group viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Shigeyasu Yamauchi, this brisk 80-minute animated fantasy flips the classic pursuit dynamic into a fast-paced, exciting collision with an encroaching army.

allowedMaterial: different take on the meeting of Goku, Bulma, and Kame-Sen'nin
Red Ribbon Army hunting Goku rather than Goku finding them
80-minute runtime and Japanese animation directed by Shigeyasu Yamauchi
excludedMaterial: later weapon or martial arts reveals
